Who Camp is for

For the nights you’re tired of figuring out alone.

  • Bedtime takes longer than you expected.
  • Your baby wakes often and you’re unsure what to change.
  • Naps feel unpredictable.
  • You’ve tried advice, but need help putting it into practice.

Come ready to take part.

Camp is a two-week online group experience for families with babies aged six months and over. You’ll put your plan into practice, share updates and work through adjustments with your coaches.

Before you pack

A few things you might be wondering.

What age is Camp Snooze for?

Camp is designed for babies aged six months and over. If your baby is younger or you’re unsure about suitability, email us before booking.

Is Camp online?

Yes. Camp is a two-week virtual group experience with a personalised plan, coaching calls and a private forum.

Do I need to attend the calls live?

Live is best for real-time support. Replays are available, and you’ll still need to put your plan into practice that day. Roll call runs 10 to 11am AEDT (UTC+11), which is the evening before in the US.

What if I’ve tried sleep training before?

Many parents have. Daily coaching and troubleshooting give you somewhere to bring your questions when things don’t go as expected.

What happens after the two weeks?

Your first month of Snooze access is included. Ongoing Snooze access has separate renewal terms. Check the current pricing and cancellation details on the booking page before you join.

Will my baby sleep through in two weeks?

There is no promise that every baby will sleep through by a particular date. Camp provides a personalised plan and two weeks of coaching to help you work on your baby’s sleep.

How much is Camp, and when does it start?
